name: Exp_BlauErgodicMDI_Tm
summary: This EA trades based on William Blau's Ergodic MDI (Mean Deviation Indicator), a momentum oscillator that measures the deviation of price from its mean. It generates buy/sell signals when the ergodic MDI crosses its signal line, with additional trend filtering and time-based trade management.
summary_zh: 该EA基于William Blau的Ergodic MDI（均值偏差指标）进行交易，这是一种衡量价格偏离均值的动量振荡器。当Ergodic MDI穿越信号线时产生买卖信号，并附带趋势过滤和基于时间的交易管理功能。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于William Blau的Ergodic MDI指标，该指标通过双重平滑的价格均值偏差来衡量市场动量方向和强度。入场条件为Ergodic MDI主线穿越信号线——上穿做多，下穿做空，同时可能结合趋势过滤器确认大方向。出场条件包括信号反转交叉、固定止损止盈以及基于时间的强制平仓机制（Tm代表Time管理）。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的手数计算方式，未发现马丁格尔或网格加仓逻辑。资金管理方面提供止损止盈参数设置，但需关注是否包含完善的仓位检查和资金保护机制。整体策略属于典型的动量跟踪系统，依赖指标交叉信号，在趋势明确的市场中表现较好，但在震荡市中可能产生频繁假信号。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on William Blau's Ergodic MDI indicator, which measures market momentum direction and strength through double-smoothed price mean deviation. Entry conditions occur when the Ergodic MDI main line crosses its signal line — upward crossover for buy signals and downward crossover for sell signals, potentially with a trend filter confirming the broader direction. Exit conditions include signal reversal crossovers, fixed stop-loss and take-profit levels, and a time-based forced closure mechanism (Tm stands for Time management). Position sizing employs either fixed lot sizes or balance-proportional lot calculation, with no martingale or grid position-scaling logic detected. Money management provides stop-loss and take-profit parameter settings, though the completeness of position checks and capital protection mechanisms needs review. Overall, this is a classic momentum-following system relying on indicator crossover signals, performing well in trending markets but potentially generating frequent false signals in choppy conditions.
pros: 基于Blau Ergodic MDI理论，指标具有数学严谨性和双重平滑特性，能有效减少市场噪音
包含时间过滤机制，可避开低流动性时段和重大新闻事件时段
策略逻辑清晰，信号规则明确，便于理解和优化参数
pros_en: Based on Blau's Ergodic MDI theory, the indicator has mathematical rigor and double-smoothing properties that effectively reduce market noise
Includes time filtering mechanism to avoid low-liquidity sessions and major news event periods
Clear strategy logic with well-defined signal rules, making it easy to understand and optimize parameters
cons: 动量振荡器在震荡市中容易产生频繁假信号，导致连续亏损
止损止盈默认值为0，如果不手动设置则缺乏基本的风险保护
缺乏市场状态识别机制，无法自动在趋势和震荡环境间切换策略
cons_en: Momentum oscillators tend to generate frequent false signals in ranging markets, leading to consecutive losses
Default stop-loss and take-profit values are 0, lacking basic risk protection if not manually configured
Lacks market regime identification, unable to automatically switch between trending and ranging strategies
improvements: 增加自适应止损机制，根据ATR或波动率动态调整止损距离
添加市场状态过滤器（如ADX），在震荡行情中减少交易频率或暂停交易
improvements_en: Add adaptive stop-loss mechanism using ATR or volatility-based dynamic stop distance adjustment
Add market regime filter (e.g., ADX) to reduce trade frequency or pause trading during ranging conditions

risk_points: 止损止盈默认值为0，若用户未手动设置则交易无风险保护
动量策略在震荡市中可能产生连续亏损信号
缺少滑点和点差过滤机制，在高点差环境下入场成本不可控
risk_points_en: Default stop-loss and take-profit values are 0, trading without risk protection if not manually set
Momentum strategy may produce consecutive losing signals in ranging markets
No slippage or spread filter, entry costs are uncontrollable in high-spread environments
